SELECT X.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.DID_ENDCONTIME DESC) AS RNUM, TB.* FROM ( SELECT A.DID_NM AS didNm, B.CENTER_NM AS centerNm, CASE A.DID_STTUS WHEN 'N' THEN 'OFFLINE' ELSE 'ERROR' END AS didStatus, TO_CHAR(A.DID_ENDCONTIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS didEndcontime, A.DID_ID FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE IN ('DIDRMODELTYPE01', 'DIDRMODELTYPE02') AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y' ) TB ) X WHERE X.RNUM BETWEEN #{firstIndex} + 1 AND #{firstIndex} + #{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM TB_DIDINFO A JOIN TB_CENTERINFO B ON A.CENTER_ID = B.CENTER_ID WHERE A.DID_USEYN = 'Y' AND A.DID_MODELTYPE IN ('DIDRMODELTYPE01', 'DIDRMODELTYPE02') AND A.DID_STTUS != 'Y'
